title: The wrong-code line on the Gym tab's join card is never tested
what: No test types a short or wrong code into the Gym tab's 'Join your gym' box. The line 'The code is 6 letters or numbers. Ask at your gym's desk.', that it goes when the member types again, and a typed code no gym has are never checked on screen. The not-found screen is only reached from a link.
expected: A test types a short code and sees the line under the box, types again and sees it go, and types an unknown code and sees 'We couldn't find this gym'.
fix_line: Add a phone test step that types a wrong code, then a good one, on the Gym tab

title: The 'Couldn't load' screens are never tested
what: No test makes the Calendar or Profile read fail. 'Couldn't load your calendar', its 'Try again' button and what the screen reader says, and the smaller Profile cards are never checked. Only the hidden retry rule is tested.
expected: A test makes a read fail and sees the heading and 'Try again', then sees the calendar after the retry, with no empty calendar that looks like no workouts.
who: members whose phone fails to read
fix_line: Add a test that forces a failed read and checks the error card and Try again

title: The 'Your profile' page is never used in a test
what: Only the rules behind the profile page are tested. No test taps a chip or types a box and sees 'Saved', removes the mobile number and sees 'Number removed' with 'Undo', or sees a chip move back with 'Try again' when a save fails. Clearing data and seeing an empty profile is not tested either.
expected: A phone test edits the profile and sees 'Saved', removes and brings back the number with Undo, and a failed save puts the chip back with 'Try again'.
who: every member who edits a profile
fix_line: Add a phone test that edits Your profile and checks Saved, Undo and a failed save

title: No test proves a member's number and name stay private until they choose
what: The profile page promises the mobile number stays on the phone until a gym is linked, and the join card promises nothing goes to the gym before the member says yes. No test checks either: that the number is not sent before a gym link, that it is really gone after the Undo bar ends, or that the gym gets nothing before 'Join this gym'.
expected: A test checks that nothing about the member leaves the phone before a gym is linked or joined, and that a removed number is gone for good.
fix_line: Add a test that watches what is sent before a gym link and after a number is removed

title: 'Remove animations' is never tested for the undo bars or for a switch made while the app is open
what: No test checks that the undo bar appears without sliding when the phone's 'Remove animations' is on, or that turning it on or off while the app is open takes effect at once. Only an exercise clip and the tab pill read the setting in tests.
expected: A test sets 'Remove animations' on and sees the bar appear without a slide, and switching it while the app is open changes movement at once.
fix_line: Add a test of the shared motion setting, including a change while open

title: A question opened just as another sheet closes is never tested on screen
what: The rule that a second question waits until the first sheet has slid away (it was lost on Android before) is not tested. Only the stored question is checked: a newer question replaces an older one. No test taps 'Delete' in a set's menu and sees the question arrive.
expected: A phone test taps Delete in a set's menu and sees exactly one question appear after the menu closes.
fix_line: Add a phone test step that deletes from a set's menu and checks the one question
